name: Upsert Drug
action_description: Upserts a medication record in the Medications object using the NDC, quantity, and frequency as the lookup key. Optionally links the resulting medication record to the given drug reference record.

inputs.name: matched_ndc
inputs.label: Matched NDC
inputs.description: Normalized 11-digit NDC of the matched drug

inputs.name: ref_name
inputs.label: Reference Name
inputs.description: Name of the drug reference record to link to the upserted medication

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the call summary record to link to the upserted medication

outputs.name: medication_id
outputs.label: Medication ID
outputs.description: Kizen record ID of the created or updated medication record
